# mc-asset

> Pixel-native 2D asset engine and deterministic CLI/MCP toolchain for Minecraft Java Edition resource packs — built for human creators and AI coding agents.

Docs:
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/main/README.md): overview, installation, quickstart, command reference, batch operations, architecture.
- [MCP guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/main/docs/mcp-guide.md): registration, one verbatim capture per MCP tool, the error model, the limits.
- [MCP surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/main/docs/mcp-surface.md): the frozen twenty-one-tool surface — names, inputs, and the read/write contract.
- [CLI surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/main/docs/cli-surface.md): the frozen CLI commands, the batch operations specification, and the exit-code registry.
- [Full agent context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/main/llms-full.txt): install, tools, error model, and limits in a single file.

Install:
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mc-asset): `npx -y mc-asset mcp` runs the MCP server; `npm install -g mc-asset` installs the CLI.
- [Homebrew](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/homebrew-tap): `brew tap smile-minecraft/tap && brew install smile-minecraft/tap/mc-asset`.

Source:
- [Repository](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset): the source tree, issues, and workflows.
- [Releases](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/mc-asset/releases): tagged releases with the tarball and its `.sha256`.

Capabilities (running server exposes 21 MCP tools; `scale_gui_asset`, `inspect_asset`, `feedback`, and `ellipse`/`polygonFill`/`strokeMask` shipped with v0.3.2 — latest release is v0.3.2):
- 21 MCP tools, not 25: 25 is the batch-operation variant count. `inspect_asset` takes `inputPath` plus `mode` (`structure` returns layers/regions/color usage/overlaps; `view` returns the composited PNG as an image block plus metadata).
- 25 typed batch variants including 9 pixel operations (`setPixel`, `clearPixel`, `drawLine`, `drawRect`, `fillRect`, `floodFill`, `ellipse`, `polygonFill`, `strokeMask`); the rest are layer, region, `stampRect`, and `regionFromSelection`.
- `apply_asset_operations` optional `feedback` (`image` none/full/changed, `scale` 1-16, `crop` selection expression, `diff` none/summary); absent keeps the legacy output. View scale defaults to 1; small feedback images auto-scale toward a 128 long edge (cap 16); outputs over the 1024px edge are `RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` with a crop hint. Images travel as MCP `type:image`, never duplicated in text.
- Selection/atomic/errors: pixel ops accept an optional `selection`; an empty match is `EMPTY_SELECTION` with rollback; `atomic` defaults to true. A 4097-point polygon fails with `RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` before point mapping; a self-intersecting ring is `SELF_INTERSECTING_POLYGON`.
